proposal.reasoning_trace: wallet:paytm has dropped to 32% success over 96 attempts against a 90% portfolio baseline, and no Razorpay downtime notice covers it. Partial success means the issuer is reachable, so the losses are concentrated in the gateway hop the code points at. Attempt 2 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on wallet after 8m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear.
